inline_text:
This PR adds the August 2026 monthly report for the Security & Privacy Working Group and indexes it in `reporting/README.md`.

### Month at a glance

- Past working group meeting recordings will now be public by default, since no confidential content was discussed.
- The Threat Modeling Gap Analysis ([#8](https://github.com/aaif/wg-security-and-privacy/pull/8)) is in active review, with STRIDE and PASTA alignment analysis underway and reviewer feedback being incorporated.
- The Best Practices Guide skeleton draft went up as a PR ([#9](https://github.com/aaif/wg-security-and-privacy/pull/9)), and the workstream reviewed Erin Farr's security best practices guide ahead of her PR.
- The Design Patterns Catalog has an initial draft and a template for adding patterns, with a repository PR to follow.
- The cross-WG review checklist workstream held its first two meetings and started the overlap checklist between groups, and the cross-WG taxonomy effort will send security and privacy term PRs to this group for review in the coming weeks.
- Meeting attendance averaged about 18 across the two August meetings, a dip from July's average of about 30 that aligns with the Black Hat and DEF CON conference window anticipated in the July report.

### Decision requested from the TC

The WG requests clarification on how the A2A donation affects working group scopes, particularly for protocol-related security work spanning this group, Agent Gateway, and other AAIF efforts. Please respond in this PR so the decision can be actioned.

### Risks worth flagging

Overlapping ownership across working groups remains unresolved, with multiple groups sometimes claiming the same areas and the A2A donation raising new scope questions for protocol-related work. A proposal to consolidate per-WG protocol workstreams into a single cross-WG effort is under discussion.
